features: C/CS lens mount, manual / DC auto-iris lens support (lens not included)
BNC output (AHD), additional CVBS for installation
Day & Night (ICR / external), D-WDR, 2D DNR, BLC/HLC
Motion detection (4 zones), privacy masking (2 zones)
Remote control: coax (ACP, Pelco-C) and RS-485 (Samsung T, Pelco D/P)
release_notes: Specs per official Hanwha Vision user manual (Manuals_HCB-7000A,HCB-7000PHA_230609_EN.pdf), HCB-7000PHA column (AC 230V model). Min. illumination values are at F1.2 with a reference lens; lens is not included, so lens/field of view are not recorded. The shared manual also covers HCB-7000A (12VDC/24VAC), which is a separate record.
